name: Status Change Request Rejection Notification V 03
definition: Scope|The StatusChangeRequestRejectionNotification message is sent by the matching application to the submitter of a request to change the status of a transaction.|This message is used to inform about the rejection of a request to change the status of a transaction.|Usage|The StatusChangeRequestRejectionNotification message can be sent by the matching application to pass on information about the rejection of a request to change the status of a transaction that it has obtained through the receipt of a StatusChangeRequestRejection message.|In order to pass on information about the acceptance of a request to change the status of a transaction the matching application sends a StatusChangeNotification message.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique identification assigned by the matching application to the transaction.|This identification is to be used in any communication between the parties.

EstablishedBaselineIdentification.name: Established Baseline Identification
EstablishedBaselineIdentification.definition: Unique identification assigned by the matching application to the baseline when it is established.

TransactionStatus.name: Transaction Status
TransactionStatus.definition: Identifies the status of the transaction by means of a code.

UserTransactionReference.name: User Transaction Reference
UserTransactionReference.definition: Reference to the transaction for each financial institution which is a party to the transaction.

RejectedStatusChange.name: Rejected Status Change
RejectedStatusChange.definition: Specifies the status that was rejected by the other party.

RejectionReason.name: Rejection Reason
RejectionReason.definition: Reason why the user cannot accept the request.

RequestForAction.name: Request For Action
RequestForAction.definition: Information on the next processing step required.
